title: truss project config
description: <repo>/.claude/truss.json, read by truss's skills and agents; the hooks don't read it. truss init writes architecture and adr, and from 0.4.0 proposes roles, deploy, writingSkill and promptOverrides, writing them only after the client approves (truss ADR-0002). Every key but architecture and adr is optional and has a default. A reader reports each problem to the client once and never treats one as fatal. It ignores a key this schema doesn't declare and unsets a value the schema rejects, so its default applies; inside roles and promptOverrides it unsets only the bad entry, and deploy fails closed: any error inside it, an undeclared key included, unsets the whole deploy key, and production is never defaulted to false. init keeps what the client wrote, errors included, and reports them by path (truss ADR-0002).

architecture.description: The architecture doc, relative to the repo root.

adr.description: The ADR directory, relative to the repo root.

agentCap.description: Deprecated and ignored since truss 0.7.0. Still accepted so older configs validate.

reworkAllowance.description: How many fresh QCs a crew may start after QC FAILs in one run, copied into a v2 plan.json. Default 2.

maxParallelCrews.description: The most crews running at once. Default 4.

merge.description: Merge mode of every run; the PM never asks. Default sequential.

target.description: Target branch of every run; the PM never asks. Default: the current branch.

roles.description: 0.4.0. Which agent type does each kind of crew work, by job, not by character. The PM uses a listed type when the session can start it, and otherwise picks from its inventory as in 0.3.0. A job left out is picked from the inventory. The QC, checking engineer, foreman and design engineer are always truss's own and can't be mapped.

deploy.description: 0.4.0. How the project deploys, for the commissioning engineer's brief. A deploy to a target with production true always goes to the client first, whatever else is configured.

writingSkill.description: 0.4.0. A skill the writer member loads with the Skill tool before it writes, such as technical-writer. Used only when the session lists it; otherwise the writer says so and carries on.

promptOverrides.description: 0.4.0. Per truss role, a prompt file in the project whose instructions the role reads in addition to its own prompt. The brief names the file; it never replaces the role's prompt, and this file never holds prompt text (P21). The hooks' rules and each role's report format still hold.

agentType.description: A full agent type: a project or built-in type, or plugin:name.

promptFile.description: A markdown file directly under .claude/truss/prompts/, relative to the repo root.
